text:
jamie: Heads up — we're seeing intermittent 503s from embeddings-service after the q8 rollout earlier. Affected customers: search widgets & recommendations. Requesting an expedited hotfix (v2.2.0-hotfix1) in the 02:00 UTC change window (~25m).
deploybot: Canary initiated for embeddings-service@v2.2.0-hotfix1. Canary size: 4 pods. Running checks: health, 5m-error-rate, tokenization-smoke. ETA ~6m. Logs streaming to https://logs.redwood/embeds/canary
maria: I'll run the quick eval set now (10 prompts). posting pass/fail.
deploybot: Canary report: health=OK, error_rate=0.6% (was 2.3% pre-fix), p95 latency unchanged. Failing check: one tokenization edge-case returned truncation on prompt #7. Manual approvals required: eng-lead, infra.
devon: +1 infra. validated autoscaler bump and fallback to preemptible pool. no resource throttles in canary.
kelly: QA ran short set, tokenization truncation repro looks like input edge-case, not model inference. +1 QA.
jamie: thanks. suggestion: staged traffic plan 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 10m observe at each step. rollback trigger: any 5m window with errors >0.8% OR avg p95 > 350ms for 10m. If triggered run: `deploybot rollback embeddings-service v2.2.0` and `deploybot set-weight embeddings-service 100% v2.2.0` (command example). runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/embeds-hotfix-v2.2
ops-oncall-bot: Alerting added: metric alert embeddings.errors > 0.8% for 5m -> page oncall. PagerDuty: maria primary, devon backup.
releasebot: Draft release note created: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/drafts/embeds-v2.2.0-hotfix1. Please review.
maria: can we get eng-lead signoff? @devon you ok to be eng-lead for this?
devon: I'll take eng-lead. Reviewed code diff, looks limited to KV cache handling for prefix keys. +1 from me.
jamie: approving staged roll. executing traffic shift to 25%. :rocket:
deploybot: Traffic shift started -> 25% to embeddings-service@v2.2.0-hotfix1. Command: `deploybot set-weight embeddings-service 25% v2.2.0-hotfix1`
deploybot: Shift complete. Monitoring window 10m started.
maria: monitoring logs + synthetic checks. so far 0 errors in synthetic, customer telemetry shows initial drop in errors.
kelly: QA cross-check pass on longer prompt set. no truncation repro on canary.
ops-oncall-bot: Observability note: added temporary dashboard panel for canary error spikes and latency.
jamie: proceeding to 50% after 10m if no regressions.
deploybot: 10m window clear. shifting to 50%.
deploybot: Shift to 50% complete.
maria: seeing stable results for 15m. ready to finish to 100% when eng-lead confirms.
devon: +1 final rollout. security review not needed for this change.
jamie: final roll to 100% now. :shipit:
deploybot: Rolling to 100% -> embeddings-service@v2.2.0-hotfix1. Command: `deploybot set-weight embeddings-service 100% v2.2.0-hotfix1`
deploybot: Roll complete. service now on v2.2.0-hotfix1 across fleet. Final canary checks: PASS.
releasebot: Release note published: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/embeds-v2.2.0-hotfix1. Please ping if edits needed.
maria: closing thread, will keep watch for the next hour. thanks for quick ops coordination. :thumbsup:
